letters: to my sweet girl, i still get quiet when you walk into a room, like my whole day just found the reason it was moving. you make ordinary things feel kept. the way you hum while you look for your keys, the way you check that i ate, the way you lean your head on my shoulder in the car and trust me with the silence. i love you when you are bright and when you are worn out and trying not to show it. you do not have to perform a lighter version of yourself for me. i want the real one, the one who overthinks, the one who laughs too hard at her own jokes, the one who needs a minute. thank you for letting me be the person you text when the day goes sideways. thank you for the small good mornings that hold my week together. i hope you feel chosen in the boring hours, not only in the pretty ones. you are my favorite place to land, and i am so glad my life gets to include yours.

my baby, i do not have a neat way to measure what you did to my days, only that they feel less sharp since you started sharing them. i think about you in the grocery line and in the last minute before i sleep. i love the way you talk with your hands, the way you get protective when someone is unkind, the way you remember songs i mentioned once. you make me want to be softer without making me feel small. when you are proud of something, i feel it in my chest. when you are doubting yourself, i want to sit on the floor with you until the doubt gets bored and leaves. you are not a chapter i am passing through. you are the person i picture when i picture next year. i love you in the messy kitchen and in the quiet after we stop talking. please never shrink so you are easier to hold. i already love the size of you.

you are more special to me than any sentence i practice in my head on the way home. i have tried to rank the reasons and they keep changing, which i think means the reason is you, not a list. i love how you listen all the way to the end. i love that you can be silly with me and serious about the people you care for. i love the face you make when you are concentrating and forget anyone is watching. being loved by you has made me braver about saying what i need and gentler about what you need. i notice when your voice gets thin. i notice when you are pretending you are fine. you can stop pretending here. i will still think you are wonderful on the days you have nothing impressive to show. thank you for choosing me back. i hope you feel that choice every time i reach for you without thinking.

hey you, come here for a second, even if you are only reading this on your phone between things. i need you to hear that you are not hard to love. you are specific, and i like the specifics. i like your timing, your stubborn kindness, the way you apologize when you mean it and the way you do not rush me when i am slow. my favorite part of a long day is the moment i remember i get to tell you about it. you turn my scattered thoughts into a conversation i actually want to have. if the world was loud today, i hope this finds you like a hand on your back. i am on your side when you win and when you are just getting through it. i love you plainly, without a performance, and i plan to keep doing that. you make my life feel like it belongs to me.

to the love of my life, i hope you know that loving you did not feel like a decision i had to talk myself into. it felt like recognizing a door i had been walking past. you are kind in ways that do not ask for credit. you remember what matters to the people around you, and you still make room for me at the center of your attention when i need it. i love your laugh when it surprises you. i love your focus when you care about something enough to get quiet. i love that we can do nothing together and it still counts as a good night. you have changed how i talk to myself, because i hear your voice in the kinder sentences. thank you for staying curious about me. thank you for letting me stay curious about you. i am not going anywhere, and i am grateful every ordinary tuesday that you are mine.

i do not say this enough, so i am saying it while i have the words in front of me. you are the person i want when the news is bad and when the song is good. you steady me without making a speech about it. i love how you take care of people and then get shy when someone tries to take care of you. let me. i like learning the small map of you, what time you get hungry, which jokes land, which silences mean you are thinking and which ones mean you are tired. you have made my home feel less like a place i keep my things and more like a place i keep my heart. i am proud of the way you try. i am proud of the way you rest when you finally let yourself. i love you, and i am not confused about it. you can borrow that certainty whenever yours wobbles.

my love, if i could hand you the feeling i get when your name lights up my phone, you would understand why i write things like this. it is relief and excitement and a little bit of awe that you exist in the same years as me. you make me laugh in the middle of chores. you make hard conversations feel possible because you do not punish me for being honest. i love the way you look at me when you think i am not looking back. i love your ambition and i love your naps. i love that you have opinions and that you can change them. being with you is the softest kind of lucky. i hope your body feels safe tonight and your mind gets a quieter room. you are cherished here. not for what you do for me, for who you are when nobody is asking you to be useful. i love you. that is the whole point.

to my sweet boy, you walk around like you do not know how much light you bring into a room, and i think that is part of why i fell for you. you are careful with people. you are funny when you are not trying to be. you show up, even on the days showing up costs you something. i notice. i notice the way you check on your friends, the way you get gentle when i am overwhelmed, the way you let me see the parts of you that are still figuring it out. you do not have to be unshakeable for me to admire you. i already do. thank you for trusting me with your quieter moods. thank you for the way you say my name when you are happy. i love you in the morning voice and in the late drive home. you are my favorite person, and i hope you feel that in your bones today.

babe, i keep a running list of things i want to tell you and then i see you and the list turns into me just staring because you are right there. you are warm in a way that is not an act. you ask how i really am and you wait for the second answer. i love your focus, your jokes, your terrible playlists, the face you make when you are about to say something bold. you have made me less afraid of needing someone. needing you feels like standing in the right weather. if today asked too much of you, put it down. i can hold some of it. i love you when you are winning and when you are learning and when you are just a person on the couch. there is no version of you i am waiting to upgrade. this one is the one i choose.

from the moment i met you, my idea of a good day got narrower and better. it started meaning you were in it. i love how you move through the world with both humor and care, how you can tease me and still make me feel respected. i love that you remember the stories i tell more than once and you still let me finish them. you have a way of making space without making a fuss. when i am spiraling, you do not panic at me. you stay. that steadiness is one of the greatest gifts i have ever been given. i hope i give some of it back. i hope you feel adored in the small logistics of our life, not only when i am being poetic. you are my person. i am so glad we found the same timeline and decided to keep it.

my girl, i love you in a way that shows up in practical things and also in the way my chest loosens when you laugh. i think about whether you drank water. i think about the thing you said you were nervous about. i think about how lucky i am that you let me be close. you are bright, and you are also allowed to be dim for a while. you do not owe me a cheerful version of the day. i want the true one. thank you for your patience with my moods and for the way you still reach for me after a hard conversation. thank you for being someone i can be proud of out loud. i love your mind. i love your softness. i love the future shaped like more mornings with you. rest if you need rest. i am here, and i am not keeping score.

to my darling, there are people who pass through a life and people who rearrange it. you rearranged mine toward warmth. i laugh more. i apologize better. i look forward to coming home. you did that by being consistently yourself, not by performing a romance for an audience. i love the private version of us, the grocery trips, the half finished sentences, the way we can sit in the same room and still feel accompanied. you are generous with your attention and careful with your words when it counts. i hope you know that your effort is seen. i hope you know that you can set the effort down with me. i love you on the ambitious days and on the days that are only about getting through dinner. you are deeply wanted. please let that be simple.

sweetheart, if i could put a hand on your shoulder through this screen i would. you carry so much and you still make room to ask how i am. that undoes me. i love the way you care, and i also want you to feel cared for without having to earn the shift. you are allowed to be the one who receives. i love your voice when you are telling a story you love. i love your honesty when something hurts. i love that we can be ridiculous together and then be gentle five minutes later. you make my world feel less lonely in a way i did not know i was missing until you filled it. thank you for staying kind. thank you for staying. i love you, and i will keep finding ordinary ways to prove it so you never have to wonder.

my heart, i hope today was kind to you. if it was not, borrow some of mine. i have extra when it comes to you. loving you feels like telling the truth. i do not have to invent reasons. they are sitting in the way you treat strangers, the way you try again, the way you look at me like i am good news. i love your curiosity. i love your calm. i love the spark you get when you are excited about a plan. you have taught me that devotion can be quiet and still be huge. i am devoted. i think about your comfort, your joy, your safety, your silly little wins. they all matter to me. come home to this feeling whenever the outside gets sharp. you are loved here without conditions hiding in the fine print.

to the boy who has my whole chest, i need you to stop being so modest about the good you do. i see it. i see you making people comfortable, making me laugh when i am stuck in my head, making an effort even when nobody clapped yet. you are strong in a tender way, and that combination is rare and i am greedy for it. i love your focus and your softness and the way you say you are fine and then let me closer anyway. thank you for trusting me. thank you for letting our life be a place where you do not have to perform toughness. i am proud to be yours. i love you when you are confident and when you are unsure and asking me to sit with you. both versions get the same answer. i choose you.

i keep thinking about how easy it is to tell you the truth. that is not a small thing. most of my life i edited myself down so i would be simpler to have around. with you i unedit. you make room for the long version. you do not flinch at my real feelings, and you do not ask me to decorate them. i want to be that room for you too. bring me the unpolished day. bring me the win you are shy about. bring me the worry that feels silly. i will take it seriously because it is yours. i love your humor, your loyalty, your particular way of caring that looks like remembering details. you are my favorite notification and my favorite silence. i love you. stay as you are. that is the request.

my sweet love, the best part of being yours is how normal the magic feels now. i still get a little stunned when you smile at me, and i also know exactly how you take your coffee. both of those feel like home. you have given me a life with more laughter in the kitchen and more honesty after midnight. i love you for your patience and for your fire. i love that you defend the people you love and that i get to be one of them. if you are tired, you can be tired here. if you are proud, be loud. if you are somewhere in the middle, i still want you near me. thank you for building a soft life with me one ordinary day at a time. i do not take the ordinary for granted. it is my favorite kind of beautiful.

to my person, i hope you feel this in the middle of whatever you are doing. you matter to me in a way that is not dependent on your mood or your productivity or whether you texted back fast. you matter because you are you, and i have had a front row seat to how good that is. i love the way you think. i love the way you care about getting things right for other people. i love the way you let me see you when you are not sure. that trust is sacred to me. i will keep it carefully. when the day is heavy, remember there is someone who thinks your existence is a gift and not a task. i am that someone. i love you. i am glad we get to keep choosing this.

darling, i wrote this because sometimes saying i love you out loud still does not feel big enough for what i mean. i mean i want your bad mornings and your good news. i mean i notice when your shoulders drop and i want to know why. i mean your name is the one i hope is attached to my plans. you are thoughtful in a world that rewards rushing, and i admire that more than i probably tell you. you make me want to be a kinder man to the people around us and a softer one to myself, because you treat me like i am worth the gentle version. thank you. i love your laugh, your opinions, your sleepy voice, your brave days. you are not alone in any of them. i am here, gladly.

my boy, you do not have to impress me tonight. you already did, a long time ago, by being decent and funny and real. i love the way you show up for the people you love, including me, including the version of me that is not easy. you listen. you try. you apologize like you mean a better next time, and then you actually do the better next time. that is character, and i am so attracted to it. i hope you give yourself the same grace you hand out so freely. you deserve rest. you deserve to be fussed over. you deserve to hear that you are loved without a footnote. so here it is with no footnote. i love you. i am proud of you. i am lucky, and i know it.

to my favorite human, i like us. i like the way we check in. i like the way we can be quiet without it turning into a problem to solve. i like that you can tell when i am pretending to be okay and you ask one more time. you have made love feel less like a performance and more like a place. i come back to it all day. i think about your hands, your jokes, the way you get passionate about things that matter to you. i want a long string of unremarkable evenings with you because those are the ones that prove we are actually building a life. thank you for being patient with the building. thank you for being mine in public and in private. i love you with my whole clumsy heart.

hey love, if nobody told you they were glad you exist today, i am telling you now, and i am not being casual about it. you change the temperature of a room just by being kind in it. you changed mine. i am less guarded, more honest, more likely to laugh at myself. you did that by staying. by being consistent. by loving me on the days i was not charming. i hope i do the same for you. i hope you feel celebrated for the effort nobody sees, the way you keep going, the way you still choose softness. you are my sweetest thought and my clearest priority. come tell me about your day, even the boring parts. especially the boring parts. i want those too. i love you.

my everything, that phrase used to sound dramatic to me until i noticed how many of my good thoughts have your face on them. you are who i want to send the song to. you are who i want beside me when plans change. you are who i trust with the story i do not tell other people. i love your gentleness and your backbone. i love that you can hold both. thank you for letting me love you in practical ways, the food, the check ins, the way i learn what actually comforts you instead of guessing forever. thank you for loving me back in your own language. i am learning it on purpose. you are safe with me. you are wanted with me. you are not too much, and you are not an afterthought. you are the point.

to the girl i get to love, i hope you are somewhere comfortable when you read this. i hope your jaw unclenches a little. you work so hard at being good to people that i worry you forget to be good to yourself. let me help. let me be the easy part of your day. i love you when you are chatty and when you are a closed door that needs a minute. i will wait outside the minute. i love your taste, your humor, your honesty, the way you care about your people like it is a serious job. being chosen by you still feels like news i want to reread. i am yours. i am grateful. i am not looking for a different version of this. i am looking at you, and i like what i see.

love, i am writing this the way i would say it if we were on the couch and the room was dim and nobody needed anything from us. you are my calm and my spark, which feels like a contradiction until it is you, and then it makes perfect sense. i love how you take life seriously without becoming hard. i love how you take me seriously. you remember what i care about. you make space for my bad days without making them the whole story. i want to be that skilled at loving you. i am practicing every day, and it is the best practice i have. if you are carrying something heavy, set it next to me. we can look at it together or ignore it and watch something dumb. either way, you are not doing the night alone. i love you.

my dear, there is a version of my future that i do not bother picturing anymore, because it does not have you in it, and that version feels like a rumor. the real one has your laugh in the kitchen and your keys by the door and your head on my plans. i love you for your loyalty and your playfulness and the way you get quiet when you are feeling a lot. you do not have to translate every feeling into something tidy for me. i can sit with the messy draft. thank you for trusting me with it. thank you for the way you love your people, and for counting me among them. i am honored, actually. i hope you feel honored too, because you should. you are extraordinary in a soft, daily way. i love you. i mean it when the dishes are still in the sink.

to my love, i want you to hear something simple and keep it. you make my life better by being in it. not by fixing me, not by being perfect, by being close. i love the way you text me the small updates, the way you get excited, the way you apologize, the way you reach over in your sleep. those are the proofs. i collect them. on the days you feel ordinary, remember that ordinary you is still my favorite person in every room we enter. i will keep choosing you when it is easy and when we are both tired and a little sharp. we can be sharp and still be safe. that is what i want with you. a love that can handle the truth and still be warm. you have that with me. i promise.

honey, i like the way you exist. that sounds plain and i mean it as a compliment of the highest kind. i like your pace. i like your humor. i like that you have standards and a soft heart at the same time. you make me feel lucky in the middle of errands. you make me feel brave enough to say the vulnerable thing. i hope i give you that feeling back. i hope you never confuse my comfort with you for boredom. i am not bored. i am at home. there is a difference, and you are the difference. thank you for every time you chose patience. thank you for every time you chose fun. i love you in both gears. if the night is long, i am on your side of it. always.

my sweetest one, i hope you feel held even though this is only words. i am thinking about your face, your voice, the way you say my name when you want me closer. i love you with a steadiness i trust. it is not a mood. it is a decision i keep enjoying. you are kind, funny, stubborn in the ways that protect what matters, gentle in the ways that heal a room. i am so proud to love you out loud. when you doubt your place in my life, come back to this. your place is not temporary and it is not conditional on you being easy. you can be complicated. i have room. i want the whole story, not the highlight. thank you for letting me read it. i love you more than this little letter can carry, but it is a start, and i will keep starting.

to you, before you fall asleep or while you are pretending to work, i need a minute of your attention. you are loved. you are not behind. you are not failing at being a person because you had a human day. i see the effort. i see the heart. i see the way you still show up for me even when your own tank is low, and i want you to let me show up back. lean if you need to lean. brag if you need to brag. be quiet if quiet is the kindest thing. i will match you. loving you is the clearest thing i know how to do. it feels like breathing once i noticed i was doing it. thank you for being my person. thank you for the future i get to be hopeful about. i love you. i will say it again tomorrow, in some small way you can feel.
